name: Arjun Verma
projectFeedback: The e-commerce project we built was exactly like a real startup product. I learned how to handle payments, user authentication, and even deployment.
trainerFeedback: Rahul sir's real-world examples made complex concepts easy to understand. He always shared stories from his actual projects.
industryLearning: Understanding Git workflows, code reviews, and agile sprints gave me confidence for my first job interview.

name: Divya Krishnan
projectFeedback: Configuring real SAP FICO scenarios was game-changing. I worked on actual GL postings, AR/AP cycles, and month-end closing.
trainerFeedback: Priya ma'am explained business processes before configurations. This approach helped me understand why, not just how.
industryLearning: Learning about implementation methodologies and client interactions prepared me for consulting roles.

name: Karthik Sundaram
projectFeedback: Setting up a complete CI/CD pipeline with Kubernetes was incredible. I deployed multiple microservices to AWS.
trainerFeedback: Amit sir's hands-on approach meant we were always working on terminals, not just watching slides.
industryLearning: Understanding incident management and on-call rotations gave me insights into real DevOps culture.

name: Preethi Rajan
projectFeedback: Building a churn prediction model with real datasets taught me the entire ML lifecycle from EDA to deployment.
trainerFeedback: Sneha ma'am's focus on business impact alongside technical skills was unique. She taught us to communicate with stakeholders.
industryLearning: Learning about A/B testing and model monitoring showed me what happens after a model is deployed.

name: Rohit Agarwal
projectFeedback: The banking microservices project covered everything from API design to transaction handling. It felt like working in a fintech company.
trainerFeedback: Vikram sir's code reviews were strict but incredibly helpful. He taught us production-grade coding standards.
industryLearning: Understanding system design patterns and scalability concerns prepared me for senior developer interviews.

name: Lakshmi Narayan
projectFeedback: Building a social media app with real-time chat using Socket.io was the highlight. The project is now part of my portfolio.
trainerFeedback: Rajesh sir brought startup energy to every session. His tips on rapid prototyping were invaluable.
industryLearning: Learning about product thinking and user experience alongside coding made me a better developer.

name: Sanjay Mehta
projectFeedback: Conducting a full security audit with penetration testing was thrilling. I found real vulnerabilities and documented fixes.
trainerFeedback: Kavitha ma'am's ethical hacking demonstrations were eye-opening. She taught us to think like attackers.
industryLearning: Understanding compliance frameworks and security policies showed me the broader picture of enterprise security.

name: Neha Sharma

trainerFeedback: Meera ma'am's attention to detail and test design techniques were exceptional. She made us think about edge cases.
industryLearning: Learning about quality metrics and test reporting helped me understand how QA fits into the development lifecycle.

name: Venkat Ramana
projectFeedback: Developing Fiori apps with CDS views for real business requirements taught me modern SAP development practices.
trainerFeedback: Suresh sir's emphasis on clean ABAP code and performance optimization was crucial for working on large projects.
industryLearning: Understanding SAP project lifecycles and client requirements prepared me for technical consultant roles.

name: Anitha Balan

trainerFeedback: Ananya ma'am's deep knowledge of transformers and LLMs was impressive. She made cutting-edge AI accessible.
